# MentorMaze — Email Authentication & Sender Domain Configuration Guide

**Official Platform:** MentorMaze by AI Tathastu  
**Domain:** `https://mentormaze.aitathastu.com`  
**Classification:** **TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION MANUAL**  

---

## 1. Current State vs. Target State

### Phase 1: Current Operating State (Gmail SMTP App Password)
* **Sender Address:** `hellomentormaze@gmail.com`
* **Transport:** `smtp.gmail.com:465` (SSL)
* **Authentication:** Google App Password
* **DKIM Signature:** Automatically generated by Google servers with `d=gmail.com`
* **SPF Record:** Governed by `_spf.google.com` (aligned with `From: ...@gmail.com`)
* **DMARC Record:** Governed by Google's global `gmail.com` DMARC policy (`p=reject`)
* **Limitation:** Emails appear from a personal `@gmail.com` address rather than a branded `@mentormaze.aitathastu.com` domain.

### Phase 2: Target Enterprise State (Custom Domain Authentication)
* **Sender Address:** `noreply@mentormaze.aitathastu.com` or `notifications@mentormaze.aitathastu.com`
* **Transport:** Google Workspace SMTP Relay OR Dedicated Transactional Provider (Amazon SES, Postmark, Resend)
* **DKIM Signature:** Custom cryptographic signature with `d=mentormaze.aitathastu.com`
* **SPF Record:** Custom TXT record published on `mentormaze.aitathastu.com`
* **DMARC Record:** Custom TXT record published on `_dmarc.mentormaze.aitathastu.com`

---

## 2. Accurate DNS Configuration Specifications (Phase 2)

> [!WARNING]
> Do not execute or publish these DNS records until you have registered a Google Workspace or transactional email account for `mentormaze.aitathastu.com`. Do not invent selector keys.

### 1. SPF (Sender Policy Framework) — RFC 7208

#### Critical Single-Record Rule:
A domain **must never** publish multiple SPF TXT records. Multiple records starting with `v=spf1` result in a `PermError` (Permanent Error) and fail authentication on all major receiving mail servers.

* If sending via Google Workspace:
  ```text
  Type:  TXT
  Host:  @ (or mentormaze.aitathastu.com)
  Value: v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all
  ```
* If sending via both Google Workspace and Amazon SES:
  ```text
  Type:  TXT
  Host:  @
  Value: v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:amazonses.com ~all
  ```

---

### 2. DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) — RFC 6376

DKIM keys must be generated inside your mail provider's administrative dashboard:

#### Google Workspace Instructions:
1. Log in to the **Google Admin Console** (`admin.google.com`).
2. Navigate to **Apps > Google Workspace > Gmail > Authenticate email**.
3. Select domain `mentormaze.aitathastu.com` and click **"Generate new record"**.
4. Choose 2048-bit key length and prefix selector (default: `google`).
5. Copy the generated public key text.
6. Publish the record in your DNS provider:
   ```text
   Type:  TXT
   Host:  google._domainkey.mentormaze.aitathastu.com
   Value: v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8A... (use key from Google Admin)
   ```
7. Return to Google Admin Console and click **"Start authentication"**.

---

### 3. DMARC Phased Rollout — RFC 7489

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Never begin with `p=quarantine` or `p=reject`. An initial restrictive policy will block legitimate transactional emails if any service is un-inventoried. Always begin with a monitored `p=none` policy.

#### Step 1: Initial Monitoring Phase (30–60 Days)
Publish a passive monitoring record to receive aggregate XML reports without dropping mail:
```text
Type:  TXT
Host:  _dmarc.mentormaze.aitathastu.com
Value: v=DMARC1; p=none; sp=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@mentormaze.aitathastu.com; pct=100; adkim=r; aspf=r
```

#### Step 2: Enforcement Quarantine Phase (Once 100% of legitimate sources pass)
```text
Type:  TXT
Host:  _dmarc.mentormaze.aitathastu.com
Value: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; sp=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@mentormaze.aitathastu.com; pct=100
```

#### Step 3: Strict Rejection Phase (Maximum Security against spoofing)
```text
Type:  TXT
Host:  _dmarc.mentormaze.aitathastu.com
Value: v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@mentormaze.aitathastu.com; pct=100
```

## 3. Required Physical Postal Address Setting

To ensure compliance with global email standards and spam heuristics, define your registered business location in `.env`:

```env
BUSINESS_MAILING_ADDRESS="MentorMaze by AI Tathastu, 12th Floor, MG Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India - 560001"
```

If left unconfigured, the system defaults to:
`MentorMaze by AI Tathastu • Bengaluru, Karnataka, India`
